systems.owner: Women of Uganda Network (WOUGNET), with netLabs!UG and the Internet Society Foundation
systems.tiers: 12 sites across Oyam district, including Oyam Daily Market; in technical testing; for farmer groups, schools, health centres and small businesses

note: A community network giving free internet to residents, class public-access; Oyam Town Council's chairperson only welcomes it, and no council office is said to be connected.
